dataContracts.contract: Canonical, indexable HTML with robots metadata, JSON-LD, and stable clean URLs
One entry per canonical indexable HTML sitemap page
Public, verified, privacy-safe, additive versioned facts only
Required name, email, company, country, service, and message; honeypot must remain empty
JSON-RPC 2.0, MCP 2025-11-25 current, read-only resources and tools

A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC SendMessage returns a direct ROLE_AGENT message with cited text and structured data; it is stateless, non-submitting, and requires explicit approval before any separate contact action
No personal information or full inquiry content in events

invariants.rule: Never mix Vested assets, accounts, facts, credentials, analytics, deployments, or Paperclip records with another company.
Do not change public visual HTML without owner approval.
Canonical URLs return HTML unless text/markdown is explicitly accepted with q greater than zero.
Direct Markdown sidecars return X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow.
Public content policy remains search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no unless the owner changes it.
A2A and MCP do not submit forms, send email or WhatsApp, book meetings, write to CRM, or contact Vested KSA.
An agent may use /api/contact only after explicit user approval of final content and destination.
Do not invent legal numbers, coordinates, certifications, social links, clients, testimonials, or case studies.
Do not expose secrets or log personal and confidential inquiry data.
Do not deploy if required validation fails or numbered duplicate files enter the build.

changeGuide.change: Add or edit a canonical page

touch: contact.html and api/contact.js only when submission fields change

thenRun: Confirm no personal fields are transmitted
Record deployment, commit, cost, evidence, and rollback in VES-406

knownConstraints: The site intentionally has no public CLI or npm package because current workflows are repository-local and HTTP-based.
The contact rate limit is per warm serverless instance and is not a globally consistent distributed limit.
The A2A Agent Concierge is intentionally deterministic and stateless; it does not invoke a paid model or maintain server-side conversation history.
Static llms, OpenAPI, and data-file reads are observed through hosting/access analytics rather than a dedicated event sink.
CR, VAT, license numbers, client logos, testimonials, case studies, certifications, exact coordinates, and Wikidata are intentionally not asserted.
Repository-local architecture files are intentionally excluded from the public Vercel deployment.
